repo.description:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

NATS Server receives and assembles MQTT packets before processing their contents.

### Problem Description

Post-CONNECT packet assembly could buffer data beyond the configured payload-derived limit and repeatedly copy the accumulated data. A client sending an oversized or slowly completed packet could consume excessive memory and CPU before message-level checks ran. This could deny service to other clients and accounts, including users of other protocols.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.14.8 and v2.15.1. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-c5hj-fqj4-pj32>
 * Credit: Thai Son Dinh, VinSOC Labs (R&D) (@sondt99)
repo.summary: MQTT packet buffering can cause memory and CPU exhaustion
